cards.x: Ni promenis tra la bosko. We walked through the grove.
La falko flugas alte. The falcon flies high.
Ŝi estas alta kaj svelta. She is tall and slender. The opposite is dika (fat, thick), not malsvelta.
Mi jam manĝis. I have already eaten. Memory hook: "I have already eaten too much yam!" Ĉu vi jam finis? Have you finished yet?
Mi skribas per krajono. I write with a pencil.
Mi parolis senpere kun la direktoro. I spoke directly with the director.
cards.h: built from: sen·per·e (without + by means of + adverb)

cards.b: to set out from, to depart
cards.x: Ni deiris de Dubajo matene. We set out from Dubai in the morning.
La stacidomo estas nia deirpunkto. The station is our starting point.
Post la koncerto ni iris al la gufujo por trinki teon. After the concert we went to the chill-out room to drink tea.

cards.h: note: koko = chicken, -aĵ- = thing made from
note: also a suffix: urbestro = mayor

cards.b: separable, divisible (dis-ig-ebla: able to be separated)
(which are) being imposed, forced on (trud-at-aj: present passive participle, plural)

cards.h: note: ĉu makes a yes/no question

cards.b: Since when have you spoken Esperanto?
How do you say … in Esperanto?

cards.f: Unu bileton al Parizo, mi petas.
Je kioma horo foriras la trajno?
cards.b: What time does the train leave?

cards.f: Ĉu mi povas pagi per karto?

cards.h: note: literally to me it is cold

cards.f: Dimanĉe mi iras al la plaĝo.
cards.b: On Sundays I go to the beach.

cards.f: La trajno foriras je la oka.

cards.h: note: -as covers both I read and I am reading

cards.f: Mia fratino estas pli alta ol mi.
cards.b: My sister is taller than me.

cards.f: Tio estas la plej bona restoracio en la urbo.
cards.b: That's the best restaurant in town.

cards.f: Estas multaj homoj sur la strato.
cards.b: There are many people in the street.
I never drink coffee in the evening.

cards.f: Ni iris al la kinejo sabate.
cards.b: We went to the cinema on Saturday.

cards.f: Kiam mi estis infano, mi loĝis en la kamparo.
cards.b: When I was a child, I lived in the countryside.

cards.f: Mi loĝas ĉi tie jam de tri jaroj.
cards.b: I've been living here for three years.

cards.f: Mi donis ĝin al mia patrino.
cards.b: I gave it to my mother.

cards.f: Mi esperas, ke vi fartas bone.
Kiam vi alvenos, telefonu al mi.
Se mi havos tempon, mi venos.
cards.b: If I have time, I'll come.

cards.f: Se mi havus monon, mi vojaĝus pli.
cards.b: If I had money, I would travel more.

cards.f: La plej grava afero estas provi.
cards.b: The most important thing is to try.

cards.f: Ĉu ĝenas vin, se mi malfermas la fenestron?
cards.b: Does it bother you if I open the window?
It would be better to wait.
We had a lot of fun.

cards.f: Mi lernas por kompreni, ne por ekzameno.
cards.b: I learn to understand, not for an exam.

cards.f: La libro estas skribita de mia amiko.
cards.b: The book is written by my friend.

cards.f: Mi ne sciis, ke vi parolas la francan.
cards.b: I didn't know you speak French.
cards.h: note: reported speech keeps the original tense

cards.f: Ju pli mi praktikas, des pli bone mi parolas.
cards.b: The more I practise, the better I speak.
